resources.string: This app allows you to enable and disable WiFi.
It contains an old compatibility version to make it possible to work with wifi.
The code source is available on GitHub, where you download the app.
AutoHotspot sends local requests to this helper to turn Wi-Fi on or off when your configured rules run. Keep WiFiControl installed. You do not need to keep this screen open.
Use these buttons to check that Android allows this helper to switch Wi-Fi. Automatic switching is configured in AutoHotspot.
This helper uses an older Android compatibility target to switch Wi-Fi. That target can cause Android to show an older-app warning.
Wi-Fi control requests are handled on your device. WiFiControl does not request internet access. All source code is public on GitHub for you to review.
Android could not change Wi-Fi right now.
No app is available to open GitHub.
